_about: Recipe rules for the CSI fluid mixing station (Dataset 2). Read by render_dataset.py; every recipe it renders is checked against these. Edit here, not in the script.

sources.tank_colors: Dataset README section 4: T100 = clear (diluent), T200 = orange, T400 = blue.
sources.forbidden_tanks: Dataset 2 page: 'Do not use T-300 in a recipe. It has a configuration issue that can also require a reset.'
sources.dispense_order: Dataset README / Dataset 2 page: each fill dispenses T200 first, then T400, then T100, skipping any tank the recipe does not use.
sources.max_total_ml: Dataset 2 page: 'A vial should contain no more than 80 mL to avoid spilling.'
sources.min_ml_per_used_tank: Dataset 2 page: 'the station should not use less than 10 mL of a selected component in practice.'
sources.max_ml_per_tank: Dataset 2 page: components may be 0 to 80 mL; 'Do not put more than 50 mL from T200 in a recipe. It can fault the system.'
